title: Dead Sea Scrolls (Qumran corpus)
edition_reference: DJD (Discoveries in the Judaean Desert; Oxford University Press, 40 vols. 1955-2009)
license: The Hebrew/Aramaic originals (2nd C BCE – 1st C CE) are public domain. The DJD critical editions and transcriptions have varying copyright status (mostly © Oxford). The Israel Antiquities Authority's Leon Levy Dead Sea Scrolls Digital Library provides high-res facsimiles and some transcriptions openly.
source_acquisition_status: DECLARATION ONLY — full Hebrew/Aramaic source staging deferred. Possible sources for future acquisition: (a) Leon Levy Dead Sea Scrolls Digital Library (deadseascrolls.org.il) — facsimiles + transcriptions for selected scrolls; (b) DJD critical editions; (c) Eisenbrauns Hebrew text editions; (d) various academic transcriptions.
external_resources: https://www.deadseascrolls.org.il/ — Leon Levy Digital Library (Israel Museum)

priority_scrolls.title: War Scroll (Milhamah)
priority_scrolls.tradition: Apocalyptic; final battle of Sons of Light vs Sons of Darkness

priority_scrolls.title: Great Isaiah Scroll
priority_scrolls.tradition: Oldest complete biblical book copy; 2nd C BCE

main_apparatus.note: Apparatus consists of: (a) reconstructions of lacunae, marked with brackets; (b) variant readings between Cave fragments (e.g., 4QSamᵃ vs MT); (c) the DJD critical apparatus. The original Hebrew/Aramaic letters where preserved on the scrolls are the main text.

damascus_dancings_link: The Damascus Document (CD) is the textual ancestor naming Damascus Dancings (Taurus / prophetic-homiletic register). The Qumran covenant community's diasporic-prophetic register is the classical ground of the Damascus heteronym.
